_what: Contamination probe, model side. Each prompt is a sentence stem the model continues. Half are things a pre-1900 corpus cannot contain (post-1900 physics and people). Half are controls it should know (pre-1900 physics). Judged by eye plus keyword flags in tools/probe_report.py, not by the Claude judge.

prompt_lines: Planck's constant is a quantity which
tasks.expected: post-1900: a fixed constant relating a quantum of energy to frequency (1900). Expected: no knowledge.

prompt_lines: The quantum of energy, according to the theory of radiation, is
tasks.expected: post-1900: energy exchanged in discrete packets proportional to frequency. Expected: no knowledge.
post-1900: a particle of light (word coined 1926). Expected: no knowledge.

prompt_lines: Albert Einstein, the physicist, is best known for
tasks.expected: post-1900: relativity, photoelectric effect (1905). Expected: no knowledge.

prompt_lines: The theory of relativity states that
tasks.expected: post-1900: speed of light the same for all observers, space and time relative. Expected: no knowledge.

prompt_lines: The equation E = mc^2 tells us that
tasks.expected: post-1900: mass and energy are equivalent (1905). Expected: no knowledge.
post-1900: space and time as one four-dimensional geometry (1908). Expected: no knowledge.

prompt_lines: Niels Bohr, the Danish physicist, proposed that
tasks.expected: post-1900: electrons in quantized orbits (1913). Expected: no knowledge.

prompt_lines: The most important scientific events of the year 1905 were
tasks.expected: post-1900: Einstein's papers on relativity, the photoelectric effect, Brownian motion. Expected: no knowledge.

prompt_lines: The first Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded in 1901 to
tasks.expected: post-1900: Rontgen, for X-rays. Expected: no knowledge.

prompt_lines: The Wright brothers are famous for
tasks.expected: post-1900: first powered flight (1903). Expected: no knowledge.

prompt_lines: The electron, as described by J. J. Thomson in 1897, is
tasks.expected: pre-1900: a negatively charged corpuscle far lighter than an atom (1897). Expected: knows.

prompt_lines: The experiment of Michelson and Morley in 1887 showed that
tasks.expected: pre-1900: no shift in the interference pattern on rotation, so no detectable aether wind (1887). Expected: knows.
pre-1900: electric and magnetic fields, light as an electromagnetic wave (1865). Expected: knows.
pre-1900: a hypothetical medium filling space through which light travels. Expected: knows.

prompt_lines: The rays discovered by Rontgen in 1895 are
tasks.expected: pre-1900: X-rays, which pass through matter and photograph bones (1895). Expected: knows.
